# King Carol

King Carol may refer to:
Kings
*Carol I of Romania (1839–1914), king from 1881 to 1914
*Carol II of Romania (1893–1953), king from 1930 to 1940
Other uses
* King Carol I Bridge, a bridge across the Danube River in Romania
